title.narrative: With a reach of 32 million and 1.9 million engagements through social media campaigns, and the mobilization of over 3,400 community members in community initiatives, UNICEF’s efforts supported drive demand and enhance community knowledge on child rights in 2024. By utilizing interactive tools, UNICEF fostered reflective dialogues and empowered children and adolescents as advocates for child rights, while creating safe spaces for dialogue on gender-based violence (GBV), female genital mutilation (FGM), and inclusion of diverse communities.
